newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks close up led by foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks close up led by foreign demand.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed up led by foreign fund demand for beer and cement issues, dealers said.
Bogota's IBB price index closed up 0.29 percent to 1,203.14 on volume of 4.4 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED climbed 0.49 percent to 18,345.52 on volume of 2.6 billion pesos.
Dealers said foreign funds rushed for the second consecutive day to purchase Cemento Argos and brewing giant Bavaria, both seen as undervalued by investors.
Bavaria finished ahead 1.28 percent to 8,609 in Bogota, and up 1.76 percent to to 8.650 in Medellin.
Cemento Argos closed up 1.19 percent to 8,500 in Medellin, but held steady at 8,400 in Bogota.
Bogota's most heavily traded stock Banco de Bogota , however, closed down 0.60 percent to 6,610.
